title: Traffic light
description: A pixel traffic light: red, amber and green lamps that cycle automatically (red 3 s, green 3 s, amber 1 s) after Start, a Stop button, and a label naming the current light.

title: Currency converter
description: A pixel currency converter with fixed built-in rates for USD, EUR, JPY and CNY: an amount, from and to selects, a swap button and the converted amount to two decimals.

title: Priority to-do
description: A pixel to-do list where each task has a priority (high, medium, low): tasks are sorted high first, can be completed and deleted, and a filter shows all, active or completed tasks.

title: Typing trainer
description: A pixel typing trainer: show a target sentence, an input where the user types, highlight correct and wrong characters, and when finished show the accuracy in percent and a Restart button.

title: Beat sequencer
description: A pixel beat sequencer: a 4 by 8 grid of steps for 4 instruments, click to toggle steps, Play moves a playhead across the 8 columns at the chosen BPM, and Clear empties the grid.

title: Mood journal
description: A pixel mood journal: pick one of 5 mood faces and write an optional note to add an entry with today's date, list entries newest first, and show how many entries each mood has.

title: Sort visualizer
description: A pixel bubble sort visualizer: 10 bars of random heights, a Shuffle button, a Step button that performs one comparison and highlights the two bars, and a message when the bars are sorted.

title: Water tracker
description: A pixel water intake tracker: a daily goal in glasses (default 8), a button to add a glass and one to remove a glass, a progress bar toward the goal and a message when the goal is reached.
